settingsform.moreOptionsHint: Extra settings that most people never need.
settingsform.error.wholeNumber: Type a whole number, for example 5.
settingsform.error.url: Type a full web address that starts with http:// or https://.
settingsform.error.tooLong: This is too long. Make it shorter.
settingsform.error.tooMany: The list is full. Remove an item first.
settingsform.error.hotkey: That key cannot be used. Try another one.
settingsform.error.hotkeyModifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or the Windows key as well.
settingsform.error.hotkeyShift: Shift on its own works only with F1 to F24. Add Ctrl or Alt.
settingsform.error.timeZone: Pick a time zone from the list.
settingsform.error.path: Use Browse to pick a place on this PC.
settingsform.error.notSaved: This works until Atap closes, but it could not be saved.
settingsform.error.readOnly: This works until Atap closes. Your settings file cannot be changed right now.
settingsform.secret.note: Kept with Windows data protection, on this PC only.
settingsform.secret.otherPc: This was saved on another PC. Paste it again here.
settingsform.secret.unavailable: This PC cannot keep it safe right now, so it was not saved.
settingsform.hotkey.prompt: Click here, then press the keys you want.
settingsform.hotkey.usedElsewhere: Used by another app. Pick other keys.
settingsform.custom.missing: This setting cannot be shown here yet.
